north_star: A source-grounded, natural-sounding, one-tap morning consciousness training platform that works reliably on iPhone with zero recurring API cost and preserves user data and evidence.

deliverables.name: Immediate morning-practice continuity
deliverables.acceptance: Voice-free Day 1 mode available in normal private app; one tap; continuous support and HeartMath rail; offline; no rejected voice.

deliverables.name: Natural voice recovery
deliverables.acceptance: At least three blind same-text candidates; no broad time-stretch; license/consent verified; Ryan selects a voice that is not robotic.

deliverables.name: Source-grounded Day 1 production experience
deliverables.acceptance: Locked 35-cue script, selected natural voice, support modes, anti-startle entry, breath coaching, full return, local package, 5-minute then 25-minute physical pass.

deliverables.name: Breath Director and Breath Foundations
deliverables.acceptance: Source-specific breath preserved; visual/audio coaching; safety/stop rules; saved preferences; physical iPhone pass.

deliverables.name: Protocol hardening and State Atlas
deliverables.acceptance: Teach/Coach/Test/Independent tiers, state markers, progression gates, raw observation separate from interpretation.

deliverables.name: User-friendly and exciting mobile experience
deliverables.acceptance: Today cockpit, morning-ready flow, source labels, voice-first notes, clear progress, offline/update status, no setup burden.

deliverables.name: Source tracks
deliverables.acceptance: Thomas Campbell and Robert Edward Grant controlled MVPs plus existing source map; no fabricated methods or paid-script copying.

deliverables.name: Local-first AI, transcription, and data reliability
deliverables.acceptance: No required API key; local Whisper and Mirror preserved; data migration/export/deletion/offline/reconnect tests pass.

deliverables.name: Rev3 verification and deployment package
deliverables.acceptance: Repository, browser, WebKit, Windows/private-runtime, physical iPhone, checksums, rollback, state persistence, draft PR, zero release.

next_controlled_action: Codex opens rfrye08-pixel/QCTP, checks out qctp-platform-rev3-codex, loads QCTP_CURRENT_STATE.json and every authority file named by it, reconciles the main-only A04/A05 evidence, implements the immediate voice-free morning mode and blind natural-voice audition, then continues through the complete Rev3 execution contract.
